content.title: Chuck Norris net worth: How rich was the mythical actor?
content.text: Chuck Norris was an actor who, since the 1970s, has remained present in the minds of film lovers. His movies and outstanding martial arts skills have cemented his status as a true icon.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoIt was during the 1980s that his legend truly began, starring in a particular type of film that propelled him to stardom. Although he is now older and focused on enjoying life, his image is recognized worldwide.Chuck lived in Kauai, where he enjoyed the wonderful climate and the tranquility the island provides. He looked to spend his time without haste, surrounded by the natural beauty the archipelago offers.The early years of Chuck NorrisThe actor was born on March 10, 1940, in Ryan, Oklahoma He was the eldest of three brothers. His early years were not easy. He grew up amid hardship and struggled with his father's alcoholism.At the age of 16, his parents divorced, and he, along with his brothers and mother, moved to Kansas, later relocating to Torrance, California.In his youth, he was very introverted. After finishing school, he enlisted in the Air Force in 1958. He was stationed in South Korea, where he began practicing martial arts.After completing his military service, he returned to the United States in 1962, settling in California, where he opened a karate school while competing in various tournaments in the discipline.The beginning with Bruce LeeIn 1972, he appeared alongside Bruce Lee in the film Way of the Dragon. The scene set inside the Roman Colosseum became iconic. It is said that to portray that role, Norris had to gain weight to appear more imposing next to Lee.This film allowed him to become widely recognized, and from that point on, better opportunities began to emerge for him in the film industry.Personal life of Chuck NorrisHe married Dianne Holecheck in 1958 at the age of 18. They had two children and divorced in 1988. He also had a daughter from a previous relationship, whom he did not meet until adulthood.In 1998, he remarried model Gena O'Kelley. In 2001, they welcomed twins. He later had several grandchildren and lived comfortably in Hawaii.Chuck Norris' net worthThis past Thursday, March 19, 2026, it was reported that he had been rushed to a hospital in Kauai. In fact, a friend said he had spoken with the 86-year-old actor and that he was doing well.However, on Friday, March 20, his death was announced. At that moment, his net worth was $70 million. Today, he rests in peace, and those who loved him mourn his passing, remembering a career that spanned decades and left an enduring legacy in action cinema and popular culture worldwide, where his influence remains deeply felt today
